name: SN Wave Runner
description: A personal watercraft for the Great Lakes — fast, agile, and a staple of Tier 3-4 recreation. The Wave Runner is the motorcycle of the water, accessible enough for middle-tier residents to own and fun enough to build a lifestyle around. The lakefront culture of weekend Wave Runner riders is one of Meridian 88's more human scenes — people actually enjoying something, even if the water quality requires a decontamination rinse afterward.
common_usage: Recreation, lakefront patrol (budget security), personal watercraft racing, weekend leisure.
story_hooks: A Wave Runner rider discovers their GPS maps show a landmass in the lake that doesn't exist above water — but something is there below the surface
The Wave Runner racing community stumbles onto a smuggling route and has to decide whether to report it or profit from it
